domain_modules.description: Codified operational runbooks executed with approval gates for common incidents and maintenance tasks, plus enterprise job scheduling, batch automation, and dependency-aware cross-platform workload orchestration triggered by operational alerts.
domain_modules.catalog_description: Take the repeatable operational work off people's plates. When an alert fires, trigger the runbook that restarts the service, clears the queue, or scales the resource, and let a human step in only when the automation cannot resolve it. Schedule the recurring jobs and workloads that keep the estate healthy, and tie automated actions back to the alerts that prompted them so every run is traceable. The result is faster recovery, fewer after-hours pages, and consistent execution of the steps an experienced operator would take anyway.

domain_modules.description: Authors, versions, schedules, and executes scripts against managed endpoints from a reusable script library, with secure parameter passing and per-target execution history. The remediation and bulk-operation engine driven by alerts and patch outcomes.
domain_modules.catalog_description: Build a library of reusable scripts with version history and parameters, approve the ones cleared for production, and run them against one device or thousands. Automate the repetitive fixes that used to eat an afternoon, respond to alerts with remediation that runs itself, and keep a record of what ran where and how it turned out. Approval gates keep risky changes from reaching endpoints before a human has signed off.
